name: Chilling Devotion
source:
A peaceful winter retreat becomes an unexpected adventure when a snowstorm leads you to the wrong cabin in the mountains. Your plans for solitude take an interesting turn when you meet the cabin's mysterious resident. As the blizzard intensifies and keeps you both snowed in.

What secrets lie within these snowy woods? Your choices will determine your fate in this atmospheric visual novel. 

[From [url=https://hereisremina.itch.io/chilling-devotion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一场暴风雪将你引向错误的山间小屋时，宁静的冬季度假胜地变成了一场意想不到的冒险。当你遇到小屋的神秘居民时，你的独处计划发生了有趣的转变。随着暴风雪愈演愈烈，你们俩都被雪困住了。

这片白雪皑皑的森林里到底隐藏着什么秘密？在这部大气的视觉小说中，你的选择将决定你的命运。

[来自[url=https://hereisremina.itch.io/chilling-devotion]itch.io[/url]]
